title: [main] Incorrect Additional Currency Base and Additional Currency Amount calculation in VAT/GST Entries when Line Discount is applied on Sales Invoice in the Australian version.
summary: Fixed incorrect additional currency base and amount calculations in VAT entries for sales invoices with line discounts in the Australian version.
key_points: VAT entries now derive additional currency amounts from their own record's local currency amounts instead of inheriting a single line-level value
Additional currency fields recalculated per posting record using proper exchange rate conversion with ACY rounding precision
Discount VAT entries now receive correct sign and amount instead of duplicating the sales VAT entry values
Amount including VAT (ACY) computed by addition to maintain exact consistency between base and VAT amounts
